blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. left Manila on Wednesday afternoon for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen, China, with the public closely watching whether he and Chinese President Xi Jinping will hold a bilateral meeting. The aircraft carrying the Philippine delegation departed Villamor Air Base in Pasay City at 3:25 p.m., less than 24 hours after the Philippines concluded its hosting of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits.
